name: Ankle lock (hold loop)
description: Loop while the submission is applied. Attacker sitting back with the ankle.

start.note: Defender start in the attacker's start frame (x right, y up, -z forward); facing in degrees relative to the attacker.

end.note: Where each wrestler ends, in its own start frame (from the clips' root-motion curves).

interruptible.note: loop: cut to a break or tap-out at any time

multiplayer.authority: server picks the pair, the anchor transform and the start time; clients seek both clips to the same time
multiplayer.lateJoin: PairedPlayer.start(elapsed) or seekAnimation on both clips with the recorded start transforms
